svg.text: One pulse-clocked flip-flop: the RS latch with its enable cut from the rising clock edge · 2 × 6Zh2B + 1 × 6N16B
As RSLATCH_J2N16 with three changes: both g3 sit on the node G (rest −12.4 V), which a rising clock edge lifts through Cc for ≈ 370 ns; 1 mH chokes in the plate loads; Rg2 12k, no Cb.
G is one net: it is drawn at both pentodes. S and R come from the slow dividers of the parent sheet (150k / 62k, no speed-up capacitor).
Heater 6.3 V on H1/H2 of every tube, all in parallel, not drawn.
